title: msswift: pickle-loads @ swift/utils/torch_utils.py:340

root_cause.note: swift.utils.torch_utils.Serializer.from_tensor unpickles a byte prefix of a torch tensor (int64 length header + pickle stream). This helper is used to pass objects between ranks/nodes in the megatron trainer path, so a peer who can inject the tensor bytes gets pickle code execution. Reproduced at function level against the verbatim pinned v4.6.0 upstream module with the real installed torch/numpy.

preconditions: attacker can inject the tensor bytes carried through the rank/node serialization path
steps: load the verbatim pinned v4.6.0 torch_utils.py with the swift tree stubbed
build a uint8 tensor: int64 length header + pickled reducing payload
call the real upstream Serializer.from_tensor and observe the marker
expected_evidence: marker written by the pickle payload inside the upstream pickle.loads
run.json with source sha256 and stub manifest
cleanup: temporary files under evidence/ are rewritten on every run
